name: Primal Concord
description: Hold the oldest concord over the host so that every soul beneath it works as one in perfect pitch.

name: First Hearing
description: Hear the first undertone of every soul within a vast reach and know its rung and its mood.

name: Undertone Mending
description: Sound the buried undertone of a wounded soul until the whole of it rings sound again.

name: Origin Rinse
description: Rinse a soul back to the pure note it had before any curse or taint was laid on it.

name: World Chord
description: Strike a chord so vast that every ally in the field shares one strength and one clear aim.

name: Eternal Recall
description: Sing the eternal recall over many fallen at once and draw each soul back within the short window.

name: Deep Tuning
description: Tune the souls of the host to the deepest pitch they can bear so that all work at their limit.

name: Silent Verse
description: Sing a verse that has no sound and presses the souls of a whole foe host to stillness.

name: Foundation Hymn
description: Raise the foundation hymn of the school whose depth and reach follow the divine energy of its master.

name: Mending Hymn
description: Sing the school hymn of mending over a host with a reach set by the master's divine energy.

name: Sovereign Tuning
description: Tune every soul in earshot to the master's own note with a hold set by the master's divine energy.

name: Shattering Hymn
description: Ring every soul across a whole vale to its breaking pitch up to the destructive ceiling of a divine master.

name: First Note
description: Sound the first note so that every voice that ever held the school's songs lends its skill to the host; no cultivation mechanic explains how past voices answer.
